pageSubtitle: Boundless curiosity, engineering that shapes the digital future
engineeringDesc1: Siskon Software & Automation does not limit innovation to developing new technologies.
engineeringDesc2: It produces transformation-oriented solutions by bringing together curiosity, creativity and engineering discipline. It strengthens its deep experience in industrial software and automation with data-driven, sustainable technologies.
engineeringDesc3: Conducting its R&D activities at DEPARK Technology Development Zone, Siskon positions itself as an engineering company that not only uses technology but redefines it.
journeyLead1: At Siskon, every R&D project originates from real needs in the field and is designed with productization in mind.
journeyLead2: Solutions developed across many industries, primarily automotive, white goods, food, and tobacco, focus on the following areas:
journeyOutro: Every project is considered a step that accelerates the digital transformation of the industry.
patentsLead: Siskon demonstrates its innovative strength with original software protected by patents, registered trademarks, and copyrights. This portfolio is continuously expanded with new patent and utility model applications.
ecosystemEyebrow: Publicly Supported Projects and International Collaborations
ecosystemTitle: Publicly Supported Projects and International Collaborations
ecosystemLead: Siskon carries out projects supported under programs such as TÜBİTAK, KOSGEB, İZKA, and Eureka Eurogia. By collaborating with European innovation networks like Eureka SMART, it positions itself as an active player in the international R&D ecosystem.

cultureApproachDesc: At Siskon, innovation is the shared responsibility of the entire organization, not just one department. Every employee generates ideas to make processes smarter, more efficient and sustainable. At the heart of this approach lies the following understanding:
capability1: Innovative solutions in industrial automation, IIoT, artificial intelligence and data analytics
capability2: Software that provides high integration with ERP, MES, energy management and quality systems
capability3: Systems compatible with global brands such as Beckhoff, Siemens and Velotic
capability5: Digitalization of all processes from production to management with Connectivity, Monitora, DSF and Trace modules under Onsuite
